# Test fixtures - NOT published data

Generated by `tests/make_fixtures.py`.

* Headers are verbatim upstream headers captured 2026-09-25.
* Team rows and the first play row are verbatim upstream data.
* All other rows are synthetic and marked `[FIXTURE]`.

These files are consumed only by `pytest` and by `pipeline/build_site_data.py --offline tests/fixtures`. `docs/data/` is never built from them.
